Enam Securities Pvt. Ltd. has informed the Exchange regarding a Public Notice cum Public Announcement made pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 8 (1) read with Regulation 15 (c) and is in compliance with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Buyback of Securities) Regulations, 1998 as amended and contains the disclosure as specified in Schedule II to these Regulations. The Buyback: The Supreme Industries Limited ("SIL" or "the Company") hereby announces the buyback ("Buyback") of its fully paid-up equity shares of the face value of Rs. 10/- each ("Equity Shares") from the existing owners of Shares of the Company from the open market through stock exchanges using the electronic trading facilities of The Bombay Stock Exchange Limited ("BSE") and The National Stock Exchange of India Limited ("NSE") (together "the Stock Exchanges") in accordance with the provisions of Sections 77A, 77AA, 77B and all other applicable provisions, if any, of the Companies Act, 1956 ("the Act") and the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Buyback of Securities) Regulations, 1998 ("the Buyback Regulations") and the relevant provisions of the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association of the Company subject to approval/s as may be necessary, from time to time from statutory authorities including but not limited to Securities and Exchange Board of India, Stock Exchanges, Reserve Bank of India as required at a maximum price not exceeding Rs. 125 per equity share ("Maximum Buyback Price") payable in cash, for an amount of upto Rs. 2,457.20 lakhs (Rupees twenty four crores fifty seven lakhs and twenty thousand only) ("the Maximum Buyback Size"). The Date of Opening of Buyback is December 08, 2008 & Last Date for the Buyback is November 25, 2009 (i.e. 12 months from the date of the resolution passed by the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on November 26, 2008). The Board in its absolute discretion may decide to close the Buyback of shares at an earlier date in the event Minimum Offer Shares have been purchased under the Buyback even if Maximum Buyback Size has not been reached or Maximum Offer Shares have not been bought back by giving appropriate notice of such date and completing all formalities in this regard as per relevant laws and regulations. A copy of the Public Notice cum Public Announcement - Buyback of Shares shall be available on the NSE website (http://www.nseindia.com) under: Corporates > Latest Announcements and on the Extranet Server (/Common/Corporate Announcements). Supreme Industries Ltd has informed the Exchange that: "We have for quite some time been considering to place more focus on investments only in product segments where our Brand Equity & leadership is established and ultimately exit from the product segments where we are neither a market leader nor a differentiator. As a step in that direction, the Company has, subject to all required approvals if any, entered into a Toll Manufacturing Agreement with M/s Kloeckner Pentaplast of Germany, the erstwhile collaborators of Klockner Supreme Pentaplast Ltd., which had merged with the company. Under this Agreement, the Company will inter alia continue to operate the existing manufacturing facilities of Rigid PVC Film and PVDC Film, for Kloeckner Pentaplast India with effect from, 1.5.2007 till the eventual proposed sale of plant and machinery. Incidental to the Toll Manufacturing Agreement, the inventories will also be purchased at actuals by Kloeckner Pentaplast India, which will be utilized for manufacture of Products under the Toll Manufacturing Agreement. The land and building will however continue with the Company for future expansion activities. The Company has sold substantial assets of Daman plant manufacturing Food Service Ware products. The negotiations for the balance assets  are continuing with prospective buyers. The Company has notified all the customers of its intention to close this business by 30th June 07. Both these products together had contributed a turnover of Rs.87.43 crores during the financial year 2005-06 and were not contributing to the profits of the Company".

Supreme Industries Ltd has informed the Exchange that the Company has on November 07,2006 signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of Maharashtra for setting up a Mega Project of a total investment outlay of Rs. 300 crore at village Gadegaon, (15 kms distance from Jalgaon). This will be the largest single site plastic processing unit in the country, when fully implemented. The Company is the country's largest processor of polymers processing over 1.16 lakh tons per annum of polymers. The Company currently provides direct employment to about 1000 persons at its four processing plants in the state of Maharashtra. The Company has 17 manufacturing Units spread all over India and is in the process to put its 18th manufacturing unit at Gadegaon. The Government of Maharashtra has accorded this unit a Mega Industry Status. The plant will be spread around 104 acres of land, which on completion will have an installed capacity of 1.5 lakh tons per annum inclusive of a part of the existing plant located at Jalgaon. The products at Gadegaon will consist of plastics pipes systems from various raw materials like PE, PP, PVC and reinforced glass fibre, crates, furniture and foam from PP, PE and PS required for construction, insulation and packaging. The first phase of the project at Gadegaon is expected to commence production in April, 2007, to be fully implemented in 3 years time.
